description: Implementation of utility functions for operating system interactions, including process management, file existence checks, system calls, PID file handling, and OS name retrieval, as part of the prplMesh project.

methods.name: get_process_path
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the current process executable.

methods.name: get_process_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory containing the current process executable.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: system_call
methods.description: Executes a system command, optionally detached.

methods.name: system_call_with_output
methods.description: Executes a system command and captures its output.

methods.name: kill_pid
methods.description: Terminates a process by PID, with escalation if necessary.

methods.name: is_pid_running
methods.description: Checks if a process with a given PID from a file is running.

methods.name: read_pid_file
methods.description: Reads a PID from a specified file.

methods.name: write_pid_file
methods.description: Writes the current process PID to a specified file.

methods.name: touch_pid_file
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of a PID file.

methods.name: redirect_console_std
methods.description: Redirects stdout and stderr to a log file.

methods.name: remove_residual_files
methods.description: Removes residual files if they exist.
